illness:\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic one month ago then she developed poor stream of urine associated with pain during Micturition since 19 days\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPain in lower abdomen Spasmodic type of pain,non radiating\u0026nbsp; with no aggrevating and relieving
